source: local file: Screen Recording 2026-10-14 091300.mp4 (design presentation; no URL; analysed from frames, no DOM)

shadows: none observed; 1px light inner border ~rgba(255,255,255,0.08) plus colour glows

taste.name: Light Instead of Shadow
taste.trigger: When panels needed to separate from a near-black ground
taste.decision: Chose 1px light inner borders and coloured glows over drop shadows
taste.reason: On a ground this dark a shadow is invisible; light reads as depth where darkness can't

taste.name: Mint Means Do This
taste.trigger: When choosing where the brightest colour goes
taste.decision: Kept #51FAAA to actions and current state (<3% of surface) over using it for headings or decoration
taste.reason: With one bright colour the eye finds the action without reading

taste.name: One Violet Material
taste.decision: Tinted every neutral toward blue-violet over neutral grays
taste.reason: Tinted darks read as a deliberate night palette; pure grays on black read as unstyled

taste.name: Tiles, Not Sections
taste.trigger: When presenting many unrelated facts in one view
taste.decision: Chose a bento grid of equal-gutter panels over a scrolling page of sections
taste.reason: Tiles let a viewer scan several ideas in one screen, at the cost of each being small
